```plato

    // The frame of a rigid pose: the pose's rotated unit axes at its position.
    Frame2D(pose: Pose2D): Frame2D {
        var x = Vector2D(1.0, 0.0).Transform(pose.Rotation);
        var y = Vector2D(0.0, 1.0).Transform(pose.Rotation);
        return (pose.Position, Direction2D(x), Direction2D(y));
    }
```
